methodologyNotes: 13 notable air fryers selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set. Seeds from the brief were verified and supplemented: Ninja AF141 (Air Fryer Pro 4-in-1) and Ninja DZ201 (Foodi DualZone) confirmed as current US SKUs; Ninja Foodi XL Pro DT201 (countertop oven) added as a widely-compared adjacent product. Cosori Pro II (CP158-AF) is discontinued; included as widely reviewed/compared unit with price from last retail. Cosori Dual Blaze (CS268-AF) confirmed. Cosori TurboBlaze 6qt and Cosori Iconic added as current 2024-2025 flagship replacements. Philips Airfryer XXL HD9650/96 confirmed (now discontinued but widely reviewed). Instant Vortex Plus 6qt confirmed. Dreo ChefMaker confirmed. Typhur Dome 2 (AF03, January 2025) chosen over original Dome as the in-market current model with verified specs. Our Place Wonder Oven confirmed. Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro BOV900BSS confirmed. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (sharkninja.com, cosori.com, dreo.com, typhur.com, fromourplace.com, breville.com, usa.philips.com, instantpot.com). Fallbacks: Amazon product listings, VeSync store (Cosori official), Philips USA product page, ManualsLib (Breville BOV900 instruction manual for max temp 480F). Corroboration: review sites, camelcamelcamel, slickdeals, and search result aggregates. specKeys chosen for real comparability across basket, dual-basket, and oven-style air fryers: capacity_qt (numeric, total usable quarts; dual-basket models list combined), type (string: basket | dual-basket | oven-style | combi), max_temp_f (numeric, maximum temperature in Fahrenheit), presets (numeric, number of one-touch cooking programs/presets on the device), dishwasher_safe (bool, whether cooking basket/drawer is dishwasher safe per manufacturer), wattage (numeric, rated watts), drawers (numeric, number of cooking chambers/baskets), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). priceUsd = US MSRP or starting/launch price. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.
